issue.title: Review execution.md write in restart marker mutation-audit fixture
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-yy.8.4 note #2 and confirmed during sase-yy.8 landing at 8eabf9ecf. tests/test_agent_artifact_marker_mutation_audit.py::test_reviewed_marker_mutation_sites_match_expected_mutations fails deterministically because the expected mutation-call tuple for src/sase/agent/_restart_recovery.py:_write_recovery_files omits a write_text call. Commit 63a5dbef1 added execution.md to the recovery bundle without updating this fixture. Inspect that new write, verify that it remains in the exempt recovery snapshot directory rather than the indexed live artifact tree, and update the reviewed tuple and exemption text if warranted. Preserve the runtime write and the audit's strictness; do not loosen the audit globally.

The full audit module failed at this node, then the exact node failed again on the unchanged tree (19.23s). Evidence: file:explicit:79c7e830663c8ae43883564f. The nearby provider-drain wait-pragma failure from the same source commit is already task sase-zh, but it requires a different fix in a different fixture. Searched ci tasks, broader task types, the last-week task list, all active epic scopes, and plausible provider-disable epic sase-mc; this defect came from the separate grok_drain_relaunch_repair tale, not that old provider-disable epic. No semantic duplicate or causally owning active epic was found.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Two unchanged-tree failures compare a deterministic AST mutation-call sequence with a stale literal tuple; commit 63a5dbef1 added one write_text call.

payload.description: Both were introduced by 63a5dbef1; restart mutation audit and provider-drain wait pragmas need distinct fixture repairs.

payload.entry: Related link to sase-zh is present on sase bead show. The artifact link command nevertheless exited 1 after its aggregate projection rejected existing pre-cutover legacy/event overlap (172 edges, including plan:202607/agent_id_reference_syntax.md implements bead:sase-ap). This is evidence of partial durable mutation followed by honest aggregate failure, not a missing related link. No live store migration or cleanup attempted; do not repeat the link merely to clear the error.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction while landing epic sase-zf (proposed on sase-zf.3 note #3): on master 26d84256a, tests/test_agent_artifact_marker_mutation_audit.py::test_reviewed_marker_mutation_sites_match_expected_mutations fails deterministically; -vv diff shows src/sase/agent/_restart_recovery.py:_write_recovery_files actual mutations ('copy2','write_text','write_text','write_text','copy2','write_text',...) vs expected 6-tuple missing the extra write_text added by 63a5dbef1. Fleet-count and research_swarm failures from the same sweep have since been fixed; this is the only survivor.

Independent reproduction while settling sase-yy.8.6.1/.2/.6 broad verification proposals: primary 2b811499c with rebuilt core 7f9a346 (0.34.5) still fails test_reviewed_marker_mutation_sites_match_expected_mutations on the extra _write_recovery_files write_text. Exact same fixture mismatch as this task; no source changes. Focused lane: 2 failed, 5 passed; the other failure is separately owned research-sw arm priority syntax. Evidence file:explicit:2db66053158f5ee6290fb55a.
